name: Weeping Carved Mourner

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril

disable: DC 20 Religion check (trained) to recite prayers for the dead, or DC 17 Dwarven-lore check to speak the history of Raseri Kanton, or DC 23 Thievery check to plug the holes in the carving
reset: The trap resets whenever a creature enters the Labyrinth for the first time.

items.name: Weep for Raseri Kanton
items.text:
Trigger A creature looks at the carved mourner

---
Effect The hallways fill with a thick mist. When the mist first appears, all living creatures in area A take 2d6 void damage (DC 20 basic Fortitude save save), and all undead creatures regain 2d6 healing Hit Points. All creatures within the mist become Concealed. This mist lasts for 1 hour or until the haunt is disabled.

text: The carving weeps. Its tears turn to a mist that covers the halls.
